text: You pay for the smartest AI there is. Ask it why you're tired this week... and it guesses.
The answer's in your apps. Meals in MyFitnessPal. Nutrients in Cronometer. Training in Strong. Your AI can't open any of them.
It connects them. Even the ones with no API.
Sign in once. Yuzu learns the app, and checks that it works.
Then ONE link goes into every assistant you use.
Same question. Now it actually knows you.
Anything that writes waits for your OK.
Yuzu runs no model of its own. It plugs into the AI you already pay for, and any agent that speaks MCP.
Under the hood, every app gets mapped once, on a cloud iPhone. Yuzu watches how it talks to its servers, and turns that into tools. If it runs on a phone, yuzu can learn it.
Every app yuzu learns, it learns once, for everyone.
ParkMobile. Duolingo. Whatever you open next.
Built today at Y C, with Capy, Revyl, and Convex.
Yuzu. Your apps, in every AI.
